content.rendered:
Arrow Collar T-Shirt Mercerised is the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and timeless design. Crafted from 100% pure cotton, this premium polo for men redefines casual sophistication. The mercerised cotton fabric ensures a smooth texture, lustrous finish, and enhanced durability — ideal for men who appreciate fine quality and effortless style.

This Arrow polo shirt features a finely structured jacquard collar that adds a refined edge to your everyday wardrobe. Whether it’s a casual Friday at work or a weekend brunch, this cotton polo for men delivers a polished yet relaxed look. Its breathable material keeps you cool and comfortable, making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor wear.
Key Features of Arrow Mercerised Cotton Polo

  • Made with 100% mercerised cotton for a soft and durable finish
  • Premium Arrow Collar T-Shirt design with jacquard detailing
  • Stylish and comfortable polo t-shirt for men suitable for all occasions
  • Moisture-absorbent, breathable, and easy to maintain
  • Available in a range of classic colors and sizes

Why Choose Arrow Mercerised Cotton Polo?

Arrow has been synonymous with quality menswear for decades. The Arrow Collar T-Shirt Mercerised upholds this tradition with superior craftsmanship and impeccable tailoring. Designed for the modern gentleman, this 100% cotton polo t-shirt effortlessly combines elegance with functionality. Pair it with chinos or jeans for a versatile, classy look that never goes out of style.

Perfect for Every Occasion

From casual outings to semi-formal gatherings, the Arrow Mercerised Polo T-Shirt fits seamlessly into any wardrobe. Its mercerised fabric resists fading and shrinking, ensuring long-lasting performance and appearance. With its iconic Arrow branding, it’s more than just a— it’s a statement of refined taste.
